description: TSLA references 1 share of Tesla, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: TSLA), quoted in USD. Tesla designs electric vehicles, energy-storage systems, and related products.

PLTR references 1 share of Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: PLTR), quoted in USD. Palantir develops data-integration, analytics, and AI software.

AAPL references 1 share of Apple Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AAPL), quoted in USD. Apple designs consumer devices, software, and services.
MSFT references 1 share of Microsoft Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: MSFT), quoted in USD. Microsoft provides software, cloud computing, devices, and enterprise services.

MU references 1 share of Micron Technology, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MU), quoted in USD. Micron manufactures memory and storage products, including DRAM and NAND.
SNDK references 1 share of Sandisk Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: SNDK), quoted in USD. Sandisk develops NAND flash-memory and data-storage products.

NFLX references 1 share of Netflix, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: NFLX), quoted in USD. Netflix provides subscription video entertainment and advertising-supported streaming.
COST references 1 share of Costco Wholesale Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: COST), quoted in USD. Costco operates membership-based warehouse retail stores.
LLY references 1 share of Eli Lilly and Company common stock (NYSE: LLY), quoted in USD. Eli Lilly develops and manufactures pharmaceutical products.

TSM references 1 Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited ADS (NYSE: TSM), representing 5 common shares (TWSE: 2330), quoted in USD. TSMC manufactures semiconductors for third-party customers.
RIVN references 1 share of Rivian Automotive, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: RIVN), quoted in USD. Rivian designs and manufactures electric vehicles and related products.
BABA references 1 Alibaba Group Holding Limited ADS (NYSE: BABA), representing 8 ordinary shares (HKEX: 9988), quoted in USD. Alibaba operates commerce, cloud-computing, and logistics businesses.

CRWV references 1 share of CoreWeave, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: CRWV), quoted in USD. CoreWeave provides GPU-based cloud infrastructure.
GME references 1 share of GameStop Corp. Class A common stock (NYSE: GME), quoted in USD. GameStop is a retailer of video games, collectibles, and consumer electronics.
HIMS references 1 share of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. Class A common stock (NYSE: HIMS), quoted in USD. Hims & Hers operates a consumer health and telehealth platform.
DKNG references 1 share of DraftKings Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: DKNG), quoted in USD. DraftKings provides online sports betting, gaming, and digital sports-entertainment products.

LITE references 1 share of Lumentum Holdings Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: LITE), quoted in USD. Lumentum develops optical and photonic components for communications, computing, and industrial applications.
BX references 1 share of Blackstone Inc. common stock (NYSE: BX), quoted in USD. Blackstone is an alternative asset manager investing across private equity, real estate, credit, and infrastructure.

PURRDAT references 1 share of Hyperliquid Strategies Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: PURR), quoted in USD. Hyperliquid Strategies is a digital-asset treasury company focused on HYPE, Hyperliquid's native token.
MRVL references 1 share of Marvell Technology, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MRVL), quoted in USD. Marvell develops semiconductors for data infrastructure, networking, storage, and computing.
RKLB references 1 share of Rocket Lab Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: RKLB), quoted in USD. Rocket Lab provides launch services, spacecraft, satellite components, and related systems.
BIRD references 1 share of Smartbird, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: BIRD), quoted in USD. Smartbird develops AI compute infrastructure.
CBRS references 1 share of Cerebras Systems Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: CBRS), quoted in USD. Cerebras develops wafer-scale AI processors, computing systems, and cloud services.
ZM references 1 share of Zoom Communications, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: ZM), quoted in USD. Zoom provides video, voice, contact-center, and workplace collaboration software.
EBAY references 1 share of eBay Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: EBAY), quoted in USD. eBay operates online marketplaces connecting buyers and sellers.
ARM references 1 Arm Holdings plc ADS (Nasdaq: ARM), representing 1 ordinary share, quoted in USD. Arm designs and licenses processor architectures and related computing technology.

SPCX references 1 share of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: SPCX), quoted in USD. SpaceX develops launch vehicles, spacecraft, satellite communications, and AI technology.

ASML references 1 registered ordinary share of ASML Holding N.V. (Nasdaq: ASML), quoted in USD. The Nasdaq line consists of New York Registry Shares, each representing one ordinary share (Euronext Amsterdam: ASML). ASML develops lithography systems used in semiconductor manufacturing.

MINIMAX references 1 MiniMax Group Inc. Class A ordinary share (HKEX: 0100). The oracle converts the HKD share price to USD at the prevailing USD/HKD FX rate. MiniMax develops multimodal AI models and applications.
BB references 1 share of BlackBerry Limited common stock (NYSE: BB), quoted in USD. BlackBerry provides cybersecurity, secure communications, and embedded software.
QNT references 1 share of Quantinuum Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: QNT), quoted in USD. Quantinuum develops trapped-ion quantum computers, software, and related applications.
DELL references 1 share of Dell Technologies Inc. Class C common stock (NYSE: DELL), quoted in USD. Dell provides computers, servers, storage, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
IBM references 1 share of International Business Machines Corporation common stock (NYSE: IBM), quoted in USD. IBM provides hybrid-cloud, AI, software, infrastructure, and consulting services.
AVGO references 1 share of Broadcom Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AVGO), quoted in USD. Broadcom provides semiconductors and infrastructure software.
NOW references 1 share of ServiceNow, Inc. common stock (NYSE: NOW), quoted in USD. ServiceNow provides cloud-based workflow and enterprise automation software.
NBIS references 1 Nebius Group N.V. Class A ordinary share (Nasdaq: NBIS), quoted in USD. Nebius provides GPU-based cloud and AI infrastructure.
WDC references 1 share of Western Digital Corporation common stock (Nasdaq: WDC), quoted in USD. Western Digital manufactures hard-disk drives and data-storage products.

NOK references 1 Nokia Corporation ADS (NYSE: NOK), representing 1 share (Nasdaq Helsinki: NOKIA), quoted in USD. Nokia provides telecommunications networks, infrastructure, software, and related services.

ZHIPU references 1 H-share of Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited (HKEX: 2513). The oracle converts the HKD share price to USD at the prevailing USD/HKD FX rate. The company, also known as Zhipu AI or Z.ai, develops AI models and applications.

STRC references 1 share of Strategy Inc's Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: STRC), quoted in USD. Stretch, the underlying security, pays cumulative monthly cash dividends at a variable rate on a $100 stated amount. Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, holds bitcoin as its primary treasury asset.

AMAT references 1 share of Applied Materials, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AMAT), quoted in USD. Applied Materials provides equipment and services for semiconductor and display manufacturing.

GIGADEV references 1 GigaDevice Semiconductor Inc. A-share (SSE: 603986). The oracle converts the CNY share price to USD at the prevailing offshore USD/CNH rate. GigaDevice is a fabless designer of NOR flash memory, specialty DRAM, microcontrollers, and sensor chips.
SHAZ references 1 share of SharonAI Holdings Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: SHAZ), quoted in USD. Sharon AI provides GPU cloud and high-performance computing infrastructure.

SKHY references 1 SK hynix Inc. ADS (Nasdaq: SKHY), representing one-tenth of 1 common share (KRX: 000660), quoted in USD. SK hynix manufactures DRAM and NAND memory semiconductors used in data centers, AI hardware, mobile devices, and computing systems.

CXMT references 1 CXMT Corporation A-share (SSE STAR: 688825). The oracle converts the CNY share price to USD at the prevailing offshore USD/CNH rate. CXMT Corporation, operating as ChangXin Memory Technologies, is a Chinese developer and manufacturer of DRAM chips.
GEV references 1 share of GE Vernova Inc. common stock (NYSE: GEV), quoted in USD. GE Vernova provides equipment, software, and services for power generation, wind energy, and grid electrification.

UNITREE references 1 Yushu Technology Co., Ltd. A-share (SSE STAR: 688836). The oracle converts the CNY share price to USD at the prevailing offshore USD/CNH rate. Yushu Technology, operating as Unitree Robotics, develops and manufactures humanoid robots, quadruped robots, and robot components.
IREN references 1 IREN Limited ordinary share (Nasdaq: IREN), quoted in USD. IREN develops and operates data centers supporting AI cloud computing.

NET references 1 share of Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock (NYSE: NET), quoted in USD. Cloudflare provides cloud-based network, security, and developer services for websites, applications, and internet infrastructure.

RDDT references 1 share of Reddit, Inc. Class A common stock (NYSE: RDDT), quoted in USD. Reddit operates an online platform organized into user-created communities where users share and discuss content.

AAOI references 1 share of Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AAOI), quoted in USD. Applied Optoelectronics develops and manufactures fiber-optic networking products for data centers, broadband, and telecommunications.
MRNA references 1 share of Moderna, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MRNA), quoted in USD. Moderna develops messenger RNA (mRNA) medicines, including infectious-disease vaccines and oncology therapeutics.

SHEIN references 1 Class B ordinary share of SHEIN Global Holdings Limited (HKEX: 0625). The oracle converts the HKD share price to USD at the prevailing USD/HKD FX rate. SHEIN is an online fashion and lifestyle retailer selling own-brand apparel and third-party marketplace products.

GLW references 1 share of Corning Incorporated common stock (NYSE: GLW), quoted in USD. Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and optical communications products.
